headline: PASS: 8 of 8 checks pass at desktop and phone widths.
target: local server (python3 -m http.server) on this branch

checks.check: the title screen opens and a game starts with 3 cards to pick, with nothing loaded from the internet
notes: desktop: round 1 offers: Tough Soldiers, Tunnel Cave-in, Flying Scouts; 14 cards in all (14); no requests outside the site; no sideways scrolling
phone: round 1 offers: Tough Soldiers, Tunnel Cave-in, Flying Scouts; 14 cards in all (14); no requests outside the site; no sideways scrolling

checks.check: picking a card starts the round: every rival picks too, and the ants dig glowing tunnels on their own
notes: desktop: pressed 1; Red took Fire Ants, Blue took Flying Scouts, Green took Glue Spit; after 18 seconds the colonies had dug 46 new tunnel cells (food: 5/3/0/3)
phone: tapped the first card; Red took Fire Ants, Blue took Flying Scouts, Green took Glue Spit; after 18 seconds the colonies had dug 46 new tunnel cells (food: 5/3/0/3)

checks.check: tapping a rival's nest sends your soldiers there, tapping elsewhere plants a flag, and dragging looks around
notes: desktop: tapping Blue's nest made it the target; tapping the dirt planted a flag at 9,12 and tapping it again took it away; the whole farm fits, so there's nothing to drag
phone: tapping Blue's nest made it the target; tapping the dirt planted a flag at 9,12 and tapping it again took it away; dragging left moved the farm 100px

checks.check: all four powers work from their buttons: fire, glue, cave-in and flying scouts
notes: desktop: at cell 4,8: fire took Blue's ants from 30 to 0 health, glue made a puddle, the cave-in filled 5+ tunnel cells back in, and 2 flying scouts took off; all four buttons show their recharge
phone: at cell 4,8: fire took Blue's ants from 30 to 0 health, glue made a puddle, the cave-in filled 5+ tunnel cells back in, and 2 flying scouts took off; all four buttons show their recharge

checks.check: a round ends with a new pick that shows what the rivals took, and taking a queen's chamber knocks a colony out
notes: desktop: round 2 pick showed “Last round the rivals took: Red Fire Ants · Blue Flying Scouts · Green Glue Spit”; a gold soldier in Red's chamber bit the queen and the Red Biters were knocked out
phone: round 2 pick showed “Last round the rivals took: Red Fire Ants · Blue Flying Scouts · Green Glue Spit”; a gold soldier in Red's chamber bit the queen and the Red Biters were knocked out

checks.check: the robot player can win, the win is saved only under gameon.ant-farm-wars., and losing shows your place
notes: desktop: robot won 14 of 20 whole games (rounds: W8 W8 L10 W10 L12 W4 W13 L9 L9 W7 W6 L6 W10 W7 W12 W5 W11 W9 L10 W10); in the game it won seed 6 in 4 rounds; after a reload the title shows the record and the only keys are gameon.ant-farm-wars.record; a queen bitten to nothing in round 1 shows “Knocked out!” and 4th place

phone: robot won 14 of 20 whole games (rounds: W8 W8 L10 W10 L12 W4 W13 L9 L9 W7 W6 L6 W10 W7 W12 W5 W11 W9 L10 W10); in the game it won seed 6 in 4 rounds; after a reload the title shows the record and the only keys are gameon.ant-farm-wars.record; a queen bitten to nothing in round 1 shows “Knocked out!” and 4th place

checks.check: pause stops the farm, Start over starts a new game, speed-up works, and it plays when saving is blocked
notes: desktop: paused at 0.53s and the clock stayed put; resuming ran it on; the speed button went to 2×; Start over went back to a fresh round 1 pick; with localStorage throwing, a game still started and ran

phone: paused at 0.53s and the clock stayed put; resuming ran it on; the speed button went to 2×; Start over went back to a fresh round 1 pick; with localStorage throwing, a game still started and ran

checks.check: Ant Farm Wars has a card right after the Editor's Choice games and plays in its frame
notes: desktop: card at position 2, after the 1 Editor's Choice card(s) and ahead of devils-burger-station, with its 800x450 cover; plays inside the frame; GitHub button opens its folder
phone: card at position 2, after the 1 Editor's Choice card(s) and ahead of devils-burger-station, with its 800x450 cover; plays inside the frame; GitHub button opens its folder
